Azerbaijani

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

республика (definite accusative республиканы, plural республикалар)

  1. Cyrillic spelling of respublika

Bashkir

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian респу́блика (respúblika), from Latin rēspūblica.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [rʲis.ˈpub.lʲi.kä]
  • Hyphenation: рес‧пуб‧ли‧ка

Noun

[edit]

республика • (respublika)

  1. republic
  2. (specifically) Bashkortostan, the Republic of Bashkortostan.
    • (Can we date this quote?), (Please provide the book title or journal name) (radio weather forecast):
      Иртәгә, туғыҙынсы ғинуарҙа, республикала яуым-төшөм көтөлмәй.
      İrtəgə, tuğıźınsı ğinwarźa, respublikala yawım-töşöm kötölməy.
      Tomorrow, on the ninth of January, no precipitation is expected in the republic (of Bashkortostan).

Buryat

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian респу́блика (respúblika), from Latin rēspūblica.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /rʲes.pʊːb.li.ka/, [rʲɪs.pʰʊːb.lʲɪ.kʰɐ]
  • Hyphenation: рес‧пуб‧ли‧ка

Noun

[edit]

республика • (rjespublika)

  1. republic
    Буряад Республика ― Burjaad Rjespublika ― the Republic of Buryatia

[edit]

  • бүгэдэ найрамдаха улас (bügede najramdaxa ulas)

Yakut

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian респу́блика f (respúblika, “a republic”), from Classical Latin rēspūblica f.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɾes.puːb.li.ka/, [ɾe̞s.puːb.li̞.kä]
  • Hyphenation: рес‧пуб‧ли‧ка

Noun

[edit]

республика • (respublika)

  1. alternative form of өрөспүүбүлүкэ (öröspüübülüke, “a republic”)
    Саха Республиката ― Saqa Respublikata ― the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) (1991–?)
    Саха Советскай Социалистическай Республиката ― Saqa Sovetskay Sotsialističeskay Respublikata ― the Yakut–Sakha Soviet Socialist Republic (1990–1991)
    Саха Автономнай Советскай Социалистическай Республиката ― Saqa Avtonomnay Sovetskay Sotsialističeskay Respublikata ― the Yakut Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic (1922–1990)
